spec.expr:
sum by (level) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea-runner"}
  | logfmt level
  | label_format level=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^$" .level "?" }}`
[$__interval]))

spec.description:
The runner's container log.

- Where the container runs its own Docker daemon, as the `dind` image does, daemon and containerd lines are in here too.
- Entrypoint output carries no level.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/gitea-runner"}
  | logfmt level
  | level=~`$errors_only`
  | label_format host=`{{ .hostname }}`
  | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^time=\"[^\"]+\" level=\\S+ " __line__ "" }}`
  | drop hostname, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport, detected_level

spec.title: Jobs
spec.description: Finished jobs, all outcomes.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description:
Resident memory of the runner daemon, each point the window's peak.

- Job containers are not counted.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description:
CPU time of the runner daemon as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.

- Job containers are not counted.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Sustained growth while job throughput stays flat is a leak.

spec.title: Mean GC pause
spec.description: Gaps are windows with no collection.

spec.title: Mean duration
spec.description: Queue time excluded: the clock starts when the runner picks the job up.

spec.title: Concurrent jobs
spec.description:
Jobs running, each point the window's peak.

- Bands: one per runner, stacked.
- Dashed line: the runners' capacity added up.
- A job that starts and ends between two scrapes never appears; `Jobs completed` counts every one.

spec.title: Jobs completed
spec.description:
Finished jobs by the outcome the runner recorded.

- `cancelled`: stopped from Gitea, or by the runner shutting down mid-job.
- `skipped`: the workflow condition excluded the job; it never ran.
- Which job failed, and why: Gitea's Actions view, reachable from `Overview / Recent jobs`.

spec.title: Job duration
spec.description:
Mean over the jobs that finished in each window.

- Queue time is excluded: the clock starts when the runner picks the job up.
- The legend's `Mean` weights buckets evenly, so it drifts from `Overview / Mean duration`, which weights them by job count.

spec.title: Task polling
spec.description:
`FetchTask` is the call a runner makes to ask Gitea for work.

- Bars: calls that failed, by the last clause of the error.
- `502`: the proxy failed to reach Gitea.
- `404`: Gitea is up but not serving the Actions API, as during a restart.
- Line: 95th percentile latency across runners, failed calls included; calls that hit the runner's `fetch_timeout` are excluded.

spec.expr:
sum by (reason) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea-runner"}
  |= `failed to fetch task` | logfmt error
  | label_format reason=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*: " .error "" }}`
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Jobs by repository
spec.description:
Jobs started, from the runner's `task started` line.

- Differs from `Jobs`, which counts finishes, by the jobs running at either edge of the range.
- Runners before v4.1.0 log no `task started` line; their jobs are absent.

spec.title: Workflows by repository
spec.description:
Jobs started, from the runner's `task started` line.

- `Workflow`: from the job container's Docker network; blank where it joined none — the job failed before starting, or ran on the host network.
- Runners before v4.1.0 log no `task started` line; their jobs are absent.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Shortest uptime among the runners.

spec.title: Capacity
spec.description: Jobs the fleet can run at once, added up over the runners that are reporting.

One row per runner.

- `CPU`: averaged over the visible range.
- `Version`, `Capacity`, `Memory`, `Goroutines`: the latest reading.
- `Restarts`: process starts within the range.

spec.title: Version rollout
spec.description:
Runners on each version.

- Two bands at once: a fleet mid-upgrade.
- A band that never falls: a runner left behind.

spec.title: Recent jobs
spec.description:
Jobs the runner started, from its `task started` line.

- Limited to the latest 500 in the range.
- `Job` opens the job in Gitea.
- `Workflow`: from the job container's Docker network; blank where it joined none — the job failed before starting, or ran on the host network.

spec.expr:
topk(500, max by (task_id, address, repository, run_id, job_extracted, job_id) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea-runner"}
  |= `msg="task started"` | logfmt
  | label_format started=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}`
  | unwrap started
[$__range])))

topk(500, max by (task_id, workflow) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea-runner"}
  |= `ep=GITEA-ACTIONS-TASK-` | pattern `<_>ep=GITEA-ACTIONS-TASK-<task_id>-WORKFLOW-<workflow>-JOB-<_>`
  | label_format started=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}`
  | unwrap started
[$__range])))

spec.title: Runners
spec.description:
Runners answering a scrape.

- A runner whose telemetry stopped drops out here while it may still be executing jobs.

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only warnings and errors in the log.
